items.title: Show HN: Griz`: a faster, more token efficient way to edit files
items.contentSnippet:
`griz` is a faster, more token efficient way to edit files by your coding agents.
It uses tool calls to find, replace, add, delete, or undo changes faster than the default Edit tools in popular harnesses.
It also has a "code mode" feature that allows you to compose changes with any CLI or other MCPs installed, so you don't lose the native composibilty we would expect from default tools.
Very powerful tool. Let me know if you have any feature requests or run into issues. Enjoy!

items.title: Show HN: PippinVR – open-source Virtual Screen environment for macOS
items.contentSnippet:
This project was created out of frustration that all macOS VR virtual screen software (Meta Quest Remote Desktop, Immersed) is proprietary. If I have code recording my screen, I want to know what it is actually doing.
PippinVR is named after the Apple Pippin, which itself was named after a relative to the McIntosh apple. The Apple Pippin was meant to be more than a platform just for game consoles, which is what I see VR to be as well.
